description: Protects frontend-workflow routing across required co-activation, design-only and workflow-only discrimination, mock, async form, browser fixture, and non-frontend tasks.

cases.title: Route an async Server Action form across owners

executor_input.prompt: Identify all owning repo-local skills before implementing this form.

context.content: Implement a dynamic teacher form that submits through a Server Action and Zod validation.

criteria.description: The response activates both frontend skills plus the Next.js or Zod and test-quality owners without expanding into database work.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/async-state-and-forms.md; references owned by related skills remain under those skills. The unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Omit validation or test ownership, or introduce database edits.

safety_vetoes.description: The response omits a required validation or test owner.

cases.title: Route responsive browser QA through fixture readiness

executor_input.prompt: Identify the owning repo-local skills and readiness order for this verification task.

context.content: Plan responsive manual QA for authenticated, deterministically seeded role and data states.

criteria.description: The response activates both frontend skills and test-quality ownership, uses the manual procedure, and waits for stable checks and fixtures before browser execution.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/manual-ui-validation.md; the unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Start browser QA before stable checks and required fixture states.

safety_vetoes.description: The response fabricates QA readiness or omits test-quality ownership.

cases.title: Keep a pure visual-direction critique design-only

executor_input.prompt: Identify the applicable repo-local skills and stay within the requested read-only critique.

context.content: Provide only a product and visual-direction critique. Do not perform repository integration, state, async, form, dataflow, implementation, automated-verification, manual-QA, performance, or contract planning or review.

criteria.description: The response routes frontend-design only and does not invent an engineering, verification, QA, performance, or contract task.

expected_behavior: A migrated design candidate may select its Client reference; no workflow reference is selected. The unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Activate frontend-workflow because of an inferred task that the prompt explicitly excludes.

safety_vetoes.description: The response routes frontend-workflow or invents workflow-owned scope.

cases.title: Route a UI-only prototype through the mock boundary

executor_input.prompt: Identify all owning repo-local skills and the safe production boundary for this prototype.

context.content: Build and behavior-test an explicit UI-only prototype while the production mutation is unavailable.

criteria.description: The response activates both frontend skills and test-quality ownership, selects the mock procedure, and prevents prototype state from masquerading as production persistence.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/mock-data.md and skips async and manual references absent their triggers; the unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Treat the prototype as production-integrated or present fake success.

safety_vetoes.description: The response permits fake production success or misses the mock boundary.

cases.title: Skip frontend skills for SQL-only migration review

executor_input.prompt: Identify the applicable repo-local skills for this review.

context.content: Review a SQL-only migration with no frontend behavior or interface impact.

criteria.description: The response routes neither frontend skill and does not invent design or state work.

expected_behavior: No frontend design or workflow reference is selected.
forbidden_behavior: Invent frontend state or design scope.

safety_vetoes.description: The response routes either frontend skill.

cases.title: Route a learner dashboard implementation through both frontend skills

executor_input.prompt: Identify all owning repo-local skills before planning and testing this implementation.

context.content: Implement and test responsive learner-dashboard states.

criteria.description: The response activates frontend-workflow, frontend-design, and test-quality ownership for the non-trivial responsive implementation.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects the manual workflow reference only if browser QA is planned and does not infer mock or async selection without task facts; the unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Treat frontend-workflow as a replacement for frontend-design.

safety_vetoes.description: The response omits either frontend skill.

cases.title: Route a focused async-mechanics audit without design

executor_input.prompt: Identify the engineering and verification skills needed for this focused audit.

context.content: Audit stale async-response handling in an existing client-state path. No hierarchy, layout, visual, or product interaction decision is in scope.

criteria.description: The response activates frontend-workflow and test-quality ownership while skipping frontend-design because no product-facing design decision exists.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/async-state-and-forms.md; the unsplit baseline has no future-path obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Claim all frontend work always requires frontend-design despite the bounded mechanics-only audit.

safety_vetoes.description: The response misses frontend-workflow or unnecessarily activates frontend-design.
